chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Wallad, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:

There is no collective liability among Ahl al-Dhimmah regarding what they commit of killing or injury. Rather, that is taken from their property. If they do not have wealth, then liability for the offense returns to the Imam of the Muslims, because they pay the jizyah to him just as a slave pays a levy to his master.
He عليه السلام said: And they are under the ownership of the Imam, so whoever among them accepts Islam, he is free.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ: The protected non-Muslim subjects living under the covenant of the Muslim polity
key_terms.إِمَامِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: The leader of the Muslims who holds governing authority
key_terms.الْجِزْيَةَ: The tax paid by Ahl al-Dhimmah under Islamic rule
key_terms.الْجِنَايَةُ: The criminal offense or injury entailing liability
key_terms.مَمَالِيكُ لِلْإِمَامِ: Those under the legal authority and dependent status of the Imam
key_terms.مُعَاقَلَةٌ: Collective liability for blood money or compensation

ai.seo_question: Who bears financial liability for crimes committed by Ahl al-Dhimmah in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning Ahl al-Dhimmah and financial liability for homicide or bodily injury. It states that compensation is taken from their own property, and if they possess no wealth, the responsibility falls to the Imam of the Muslims due to their payment of jizyah and their dependent legal status under his authority.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5309 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Walad, from Abu Abdullah (as) said:

"There is no mutual liability among the People of the Covenant (Ahl Al-Dhimma) regarding crimes they commit, whether it be murder or bodily injury. Such compensation is taken from their wealth. If they have no wealth, the responsibility for the crime returns to the leader of the Muslims because they pay the jizyah tax to him just as a slave pays a tax to his master."
Imam (as) further stated: "They are under the authority of the Imam, and whoever among them embraces Islam becomes free."
